131. Removal of Members for misconduct.—

—   The prescribed authority if it thinks fit 
on the recommendations of the Zilla Panchayat, may remove any member after giving 
him an opportunity of being heard and after such enquiry as it deems necessary if such 
member has been guilty of misconduct in the discharge of his duties or any disgraceful 
conduct, or has become incapable of performing his duties as a member.
